s: a tiny, near-abandoned 13th-century church on a remote Menai shore
w: A small, plain medieval church standing almost alone in fields near the Menai Strait outside Caernarfon, largely unaltered since it fell out of regular use. No electricity, no modern intrusion -- box pews, bare stone and the quiet of a building time genuinely passed over. One of the most atmospheric of Wales's redundant churches.
_facts: Medieval church at Llanfaglan, near Caernarfon, Gwynedd, dating from at least the 13th century
Now a redundant church cared for by the Friends of Friendless Churches
Retains 18th/19th-century box pews and has no electricity supply
Sits in an isolated position in fields close to the Menai Strait
